desc: Derive incremental cost structure: monotonic stack of (level, count) segments; correct orientation is l moving right-to-left with push-left (merge leading lower segments) and pop-right (exact, O(1)); verified by hand on Example 1 yielding 17.
Implement Solution.countNonDecreasingSubarrays: right-to-left sweep, deque of [level, count], push_left/pop_right helpers, main loop with cost invariant and answer accumulation.
Validate against both provided examples (17 and 12), brute-force randomized tests for small n, and edge cases (n=1, monotone arrays, huge values/k, k=0).
Confirm complexity O(n) time / O(n) space and finalize code within the required delimiters.
